notes: Standard Source RCON over TCP; works with mcrcon. Enabled in ConanSandbox/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/Game.ini under [RconPlugin] with RconEnabled=1, RconPassword=, RconPort=25575, RconMaxKarma=60 (wiki, gameserverkings and xgamingserver agree on section and port). Funcom has never published an official RCON command reference - the list here is the server's own 'help' output as transcribed by Pingperfect and BisectHosting, which agree verbatim: 'kickplayer (index|name|userid|platformid|player) <identification> <message>', 'banplayer (index|name|userid|platformid|player) <identification> <message>', 'unbanplayer <userid|platformid>', 'listplayers', 'listbans', 'broadcast <message>'. The selector keyword is mandatory: 'platformid' selects the Steam64 id, 'userid' the FuncomID. DISAGREEMENT: HostHavoc documents 'kickplayer <steamid>' / 'banplayer <steamid>' and supercraft.host documents 'kickplayer <name>' / 'banplayer <name>', both without the selector keyword; those look like the pre-crossplay (pre-Age of Sorcery) syntax and are believed outdated. banplayer takes no duration - Conan Exiles bans are permanent until unbanplayer. No server-status command was confirmed, so 'info' is omitted rather than guessed; there is no MOTD command (ServerMessageOfTheDay is a ServerSettings.ini value). playerParse is the weakest part of this file: the listplayers response is a pipe-delimited table whose header is reported as 'Idx | Char name | Player name | User ID | Platform ID | Platform Name', but no source quotes real output, so the column positions are inferred - confidence is 'low' for that reason plus the kick/ban syntax disagreement above.
